question: How is the certainty of this declared method illustrated by comparison?
premises: The thunderbolt of the king of gods is invoked as a comparison.
The method is uttered by the speaker.
The comparison implies firmness or certainty.
inference: The declared method is presented as certain, like the thunderbolt of the king of gods.
plain_english: As the thunderbolt of the king of gods is certain, so this method has been declared by me.
